# Èlor Studio & Academy

> Èlor Studio & Academy is a beauty studio concept taking shape in Perumbakkam, Chennai, India. The website presents South Indian bridal artistry, beauty editorials, imagined wellness rituals and a future beauty academy.

The physical studio is in development. Its architectural visualizations and facilities are conceptual and subject to design and approvals. Opening details will be announced.

Public contact details are helen@elor.studio and +91 94420 31002.

## Explore Èlor

- [Official website](https://elor.studio/): Introduction to Èlor Studio & Academy.
- [Bridal Multiverse](https://elor.studio/#bridal-worlds): Bridal editorial directions inspired by South Indian heritage, expression and craft.
- [The House](https://elor.studio/#house): Architectural concepts for the proposed Perumbakkam studio.
- [The Ritual](https://elor.studio/#ritual): An imagined wellness ritual centered on water, touch and stillness.
- [The Living Lookbook](https://elor.studio/#lookbook): Editorial images of bridal beauty, hair and spaces.
- [The Light Room](https://elor.studio/#light-room): A cinematic portrait study of light, expression and craft.
- [The Academy](https://elor.studio/#academy): A future learning studio for beauty technique and creative development.

## Get in Touch
